whyVietnam.title: Why source from Vietnam
whyVietnam.metaDescription: Why global buyers source from Vietnam: 16 free-trade agreements, competitive labour costs, a 56-million-strong workforce and $400B+ in annual exports across electronics, apparel, furniture and more.

fta.label: Free-trade agreements
fta.body: EVFTA, CPTPP, UKVFTA, RCEP and more reduce or remove duties in the EU, UK, Japan, Canada and Australia.

exports.label: Annual exports
exports.body: Electronics, apparel, footwear, furniture, machinery, seafood and coffee lead the way.

workforce.label: Working-age population
workforce.body: Young, literate and experienced in export manufacturing; median age 33.

cost.label: Lower labour cost than China
cost.body: Competitive wages with rapidly rising productivity in export processing zones.

growth.label: Average GDP growth
growth.body: One of Asia's fastest-growing economies for two decades.

ports.label: Deep-water port complexes
ports.body: Cai Mep–Thi Vai, Lach Huyen and Da Nang connect factories to every major trade lane.

faq.q1: Is Vietnam cheaper than China for manufacturing?
faq.a1: For labour-intensive categories such as garments, footwear, furniture and bags, Vietnamese factory labour typically costs 30–50% less than coastal China, while quality and export experience are comparable. For highly automated categories the gap is smaller, so buyers compare landed cost, not just unit price.
faq.q2: Which products is Vietnam best known for?
faq.a2: Vietnam is the world's second-largest exporter of apparel and footwear, a top-five furniture exporter and a fast-growing electronics assembly hub (smartphones, components, consumer electronics). Packaging, plastics, machinery parts, seafood, coffee and cashews are also major export categories.
faq.q3: How do free-trade agreements help my imports?
faq.a3: Under EVFTA (EU), UKVFTA (UK), CPTPP (Japan, Canada, Australia, Mexico and others) and RCEP, most Vietnamese-origin goods enter with reduced or zero duty once rules of origin are met. Your supplier issues the certificate of origin; CANG guides list the documents per market.
faq.q4: How long does production and shipping take?
faq.a4: Typical lead times on CANG are 30–60 days for production after sample approval. Sea freight adds roughly 25–35 days to Europe, 20–30 days to the US West Coast and 7–12 days within Asia.
faq.q5: How do I verify a Vietnamese supplier?
faq.a5: Look for the Verified Manufacturer badge (business registration, tax code and factory ownership checked by CANG), certifications on file, buyer reviews from completed orders and, for larger orders, a third-party factory audit booked through the Inspection service.

whyVietnam.ctaBody: Browse verified manufacturers by industry and province, or post an RFQ and let matching factories quote.

tradeAssurance.title: Trade Assurance
tradeAssurance.metaDescription: How CANG Trade Assurance protects payments: funds held by a licensed partner bank, released on confirmed milestones, with inspection and dispute mediation. CANG never holds client money.
tradeAssurance.subtitle: Pay with confidence. Your deposit and balance sit in a segregated account at a licensed Vietnamese partner bank and are released to the factory only when agreed milestones are confirmed.

coverage.c1Body: If the supplier fails to ship by the agreed date, your funds are refunded in full from the escrow account.
coverage.c2Title: Quality does not match the order
coverage.c2Body: Open a dispute within the inspection window with photos or an inspection report; a CANG mediator facilitates refund, replacement or price adjustment.
coverage.c3Body: Shortages and deviations from the agreed specification are covered up to the order value.
coverage.c4Body: Release requires the shipping documents defined in the order (B/L or AWB, packing list, invoice, certificate of origin).

tradeAssurance.disputesBody: Either party can open a dispute from the order page. Both sides submit evidence; a CANG mediator proposes a resolution within 5 business days. If unresolved, the escrow instruction follows the outcome of the partner bank's dispute procedure.

disputeSteps.s1: Open dispute within the inspection window
disputeSteps.s4: Refund, partial refund, replacement or release

tradeAssurance.disclaimer: CANG never holds client money. Escrow-style protection is provided by licensed Vietnamese partner banks under the State Bank of Vietnam's supervision. CANG operates the marketplace, instructs milestone releases and mediates disputes.
tradeAssurance.fees: Trade Assurance is included in the platform commission on protected orders. There is no separate fee for buyers.

faq.a1: A licensed Vietnamese partner bank holds funds in a segregated escrow-style account in your order's name. CANG never takes possession of client money.
faq.a2: Funds are released according to the payment schedule in the order — typically a deposit on production start and the balance on shipping documents or delivery confirmation.
faq.q3: Can I add a third-party inspection?
faq.a3: Yes. Book a pre-shipment inspection from the order page; release of the final balance can be conditioned on a passed inspection report.
faq.q4: How long do I have to raise a dispute?
faq.a4: The inspection window is defined in the order (7 days by default after delivery confirmation). Disputes raised within the window pause the final release.
faq.a5: International bank transfer (SWIFT) in USD or EUR, and domestic transfer in VND for Vietnamese buyers. Card and trade-finance options are offered by partners on eligible orders.

tradeAssurance.ctaBody: Every order on CANG can be protected. Start with an RFQ or browse products with tiered pricing.
tradeAssurance.platformLine: CANG is a technology platform and never holds client money — funds sit with licensed partner institutions.

logistics.title: Logistics
logistics.metaDescription: Book sea, air and rail freight from Vietnam with CANG's partner forwarders: factory pickup, warehousing, customs brokerage, insurance and milestone tracking inside your order.
logistics.subtitle: Freight quotes from licensed partner forwarders, booked inside your order and tracked milestone by milestone from the factory gate to your warehouse.

serviceBodies.SEA_FREIGHT: Full and less-than-container loads from Cat Lai, Cai Mep–Thi Vai, Hai Phong and Da Nang to every major port.
serviceBodies.AIR_FREIGHT: Samples, urgent replenishment and high-value goods from SGN and HAN, door to door.
serviceBodies.RAIL_FREIGHT: China–Europe rail via Hanoi for 18–22 day transit to Central Europe at sea-like rates.
serviceBodies.CUSTOMS_BROKERAGE: Export declarations, certificates of origin (EVFTA, CPTPP, RCEP) and import clearance at destination.
serviceBodies.WAREHOUSING: Consolidate multiple suppliers into one shipment at partner warehouses near the ports.
serviceBodies.CARGO_INSURANCE: All-risk marine insurance quoted with your freight.

logistics.flowTitle: From factory gate to your door
logistics.providersBody: Licensed forwarders integrated with CANG. Request quotes from several at once from your order.
logistics.ctaBody: Freight is requested from the order page after a quotation is accepted. Not ready? Post an RFQ to start.
logistics.disclaimer: Logistics services are provided by independent, licensed forwarders and carriers. CANG coordinates quotes, bookings and tracking but is not the carrier of record.

financing.title: Trade financing
financing.metaDescription: Working-capital and production financing for Vietnamese factories, import financing and buy-now-pay-later for international buyers — from regulated lenders integrated with CANG.
financing.subtitle: Regulated lenders integrated with your CANG orders: factories fund production against purchase orders, buyers pay on terms.
financing.forBuyersBody: Pay suppliers upfront through Trade Assurance while you settle with the lender on 30–120 day terms.
financing.forSellersBody: Turn an accepted purchase order into working capital before the buyer's balance arrives.

productBodies.IMPORT_FINANCING: Finance the landed cost of an order; repay after goods arrive and sell through.
productBodies.BNPL: Split the order into instalments over 60–120 days with a partner fintech.
productBodies.PURCHASE_FINANCING: Credit line drawn per order, secured by the goods and Trade Assurance documents.
productBodies.WORKING_CAPITAL: Revolving facility sized on your CANG transaction history.
productBodies.PRODUCTION_FINANCING: Advance up to 70% of an accepted PO to buy materials and pay wages.
productBodies.PURCHASE_ORDER_FINANCING: Lender pays your material suppliers directly against the buyer's PO.
productBodies.INVOICE_FACTORING: Sell the export invoice at shipment and receive cash within 48 hours, non-recourse.
productBodies.RECEIVABLES_FINANCING: Borrow against outstanding export receivables from verified buyers.
productBodies.INVOICE_FINANCING: Short-term advance against issued invoices on completed orders.

how.s1: Apply from an order or your dashboard — CANG pre-fills company, order and transaction data.
how.s2: Your application is routed to the lender whose criteria you match. Decisions typically within 3 business days.
how.s3: Accept the offer; disbursement flows into the order's payment schedule and repayments are tracked in your dashboard.

financing.eligibilityBody: Verified companies with at least one completed order on CANG, or a signed purchase order from a verified counterparty. Lenders run their own credit and KYC checks.
financing.disclaimer: CANG is not a lender and does not provide credit, guarantees or financial advice. Financing products are offered by independent, regulated institutions under their own terms; approval and pricing are at their discretion. Indicative rates shown are for illustration.
financing.ctaBody: Sign in and open Financing in your dashboard to see the products available to your company.

inspection.title: Quality inspection
inspection.metaDescription: Book factory audits and pre-production, during-production, pre-shipment and container-loading inspections in Vietnam through CANG's partner inspection companies. AQL sampling, reports within 24 hours.
inspection.subtitle: Independent inspectors across Vietnam, booked from your order. Reports with photos and AQL results land in your dashboard within 24 hours.

typeBodies.FACTORY_AUDIT: On-site verification of legal status, capacity, equipment, quality systems and social compliance before you commit to a supplier.
typeBodies.PRE_PRODUCTION: Checks raw materials, components and the approved sample against your specification before mass production starts.
typeBodies.DURING_PRODUCTION: Inspection at 20–60% completion to catch defects early and confirm the schedule.
typeBodies.PRE_SHIPMENT: AQL sampling of finished, packed goods for workmanship, function, labelling and packaging.
typeBodies.CONTAINER_LOADING: Supervision of quantity, carton condition and container sealing on loading day.

how.s1: Choose the inspection type and date from the order page; the factory is notified automatically.
how.s2: The partner sends a local inspector; findings are recorded against your specification and AQL level.
how.s3: The report is uploaded to the order. If tied to Trade Assurance, the final payment waits for a passed report.

inspection.pricingBody: Inspections are quoted per man-day by the partner (typically USD 250–350 in Vietnam, travel included). Factory audits are quoted per scope.
inspection.disclaimer: Inspections are performed by independent, accredited inspection companies. Reports reflect the inspector's findings on the day; CANG does not certify products.
inspection.ctaBody: Inspections are booked from an order. Start with an RFQ or browse verified manufacturers.

pricing.title: Plans & pricing for suppliers
pricing.metaDescription: CANG supplier plans: list products for free, upgrade for priority RFQs, verification, analytics and lead generation. Buyers always use CANG for free.
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you want more visibility, verification and buyer leads. Buyers never pay to source on CANG.
pricing.commissionBody: A success-based commission of 2–5% (by category) applies to orders completed with Trade Assurance and is invoiced to the supplier after payment release. No commission on orders you settle outside the platform.
pricing.buyersBody: Posting RFQs, comparing quotations, messaging suppliers and using Trade Assurance costs nothing. Optional services (inspection, freight, financing) are quoted by partners per order.

faq.a1: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately with a pro-rated charge; downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.
faq.a2: Pro includes business verification (registration, tax code, ownership documents). Verified Manufacturer adds an on-site factory audit and the Factory Audited badge.
faq.a3: Bank transfer in VND or USD, or card through a partner payment provider. Invoices with VAT are issued automatically.
faq.a4: Monthly plans renew monthly and can be cancelled any time. Yearly plans are billed once for 12 months at a discount.
faq.q5: Do buyers see which plan I am on?
faq.a5: No. Buyers see your badges, verification status, reviews and response rate — not your plan.

pricing.cta2Body: List your first products in under 30 minutes. Our onboarding team in Ho Chi Minh City can help in Vietnamese or English.
